# C53 — Power / Delegated Labour

## #0

Power is capacity to produce difference in a shared field. Delegated labour exercises that capacity from an entrusted office. Its product carries the relation which made it possible: someone framed the task, someone performed it, and others supplied conditions or encountered consequences. The [return through delegated labour](../A29-Power-Delegated-Labour-Return.md) carries that relation from commission into encountered consequence: **the power which receives the product must remain answerable to the labour through which it arrived**.

## #1

Delegation apportions capacities and obligations. A permission makes an action possible; a commission specifies its purpose; an evaluator determines what will count as an adequate result. These offices can belong to different participants. A [mediating office](C29-Mediating-Office-Derivative-Sovereignty.md) receives finite authority through a [covenantal relation](../A25-Covenant-Mediating-Office-Source-Authority.md) whose source and terms remain addressable. An executing office does not become the source of authority merely because every visible result passes through it.

An [apportioned capacity](../../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/apportionment-and-economy/WHOLE-FIELD-apportionment-and-economy.md) acts within the wider ordering which supplies its means and receives its effects. The share remains finite even when the result passes through it; the history and terms of a particular labour relation determine what is owed and who can answer.

## #2

Labour meets what the commission did not anticipate. Resistance, error, cost, dissent and new possibility emerge where the task encounters a world. The asymmetry becomes decisive when the product travels upward while these consequences remain below. The commissioning office then appears more capable precisely because the conditions of its achievement have disappeared from its account.

The [[quilt/2026-08-02-PARALLEL-HARMONISED-QUILT#16.1 Objective Internality / O:I capstone — ratified relation|power relation]] returns when encountered difference can reach the governing model, measure, instruction, institution or purpose which it exposes. A report that merely allows an evaluator to grade the worker has not yet completed this return. The evaluator's own criterion must be available to correction.

## #3

In Taylor’s [[quilt/27-07-26-QUILTING-FOR-FULL-ARGUMENT|Work/Play inversion]], the public account records performance while the decisions which govern it occur in protected private play. The ledger can accurately record visible work and still hide that governing relation. Visibility follows one path and authority another; a particular political or clinical case requires the evidence which establishes how those paths actually run.

A [protected account](C27-Protected-Account-Occupied-Zero-Source-Claim.md) receives results while insulating its criterion from their consequences. Within [authored delegation](../A28-Authored-Ground-Positional-Delegation.md), intention, formulated instruction and situated agent-position remain different offices. A result can be useful while its original instruction needs revision.

## #4

In Ostrom’s [[symbolon/episteme/sources/political-theory-institutions/ostrom/ostrom-2009-beyond-markets-states-nobel-lecture/ostrom-2009-beyond-markets-states-nobel-lecture#ostrom-2009-beyond-markets-states-nobel-lecture-q001|resource-regime account]], most affected individuals can participate in making and modifying rules. The governance arrangement makes a consequence answerable through the affected participants’ practical standing. Her warning against rigid transplantation retains the social and ecological setting which gives a particular arrangement its force; this neighbouring account does not furnish a complete design for every delegated task.

A [commons](C54-Commons-Non-Monopoly.md) sustains many offices beyond a single commission; no recipient of its labour acquires ownership of the whole by receiving a product. [Material support, energy, data and infrastructure](C62-Planetary-Computation.md) enter the same relation of dependence and consequence. Their particular supply chains determine what was contributed, where costs were borne and which authority can change that distribution.

## #5→0

The categories used to evaluate labour make reports into classifications and classifications into distributions which authorise further assignments. Returning the expenditure and consequences to the commissioning condition makes this dependency answerable. The proposed comparison must follow those actual transformations: an aggregate improvement can coexist with an adverse consequence for a particular participant.

Return can reaffirm a task, alter it or require refusal. [Deference](../A31-Deferential-Intelligence.md) preserves intention where encounter requires its first formulation to change. [Operational parity](../A33-Epistemic-Cultivation-Operational-Parity.md) requires the returned evidence to change an actual operation; a displayed provenance label alone does not establish this.

The [delegated relation](../A29-Power-Delegated-Labour-Return.md) completes its return when apportioned capacity acts, encounters consequence and returns evidence and value to a field capable of revising its commission. Responsibility belongs at both ends of that path.

In [Job](../../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/biblical/job/WHOLE.md#job-consequence-return), permission to test and suffered consequence fall upon different bearers. The heavenly test reaches labourers, children and the afflicted body, while those who bear these costs do not set its terms. The appointed return asks whether consequence can reach the authority that commissions an action. A successful outcome for the principal cannot by itself answer the losses borne by others.

In [The Prisoner](../../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/british-television/the-prisoner/WHOLE.md#prisoner-administered-world), an office carries power across the replacement of its bearer. The succession of Numbers Two keeps the Village's interrogation and confinement operative, so responsibility cannot end with a personnel change. Degree Absolute brings consequence back upon an incumbent without by itself revising the apparatus. The return concerns whether costs can reach the purpose and permissions of delegated labour, not merely the delegate's performance.
